evidence: Primary paper/guides plus recovered official 1.1.1 archive. Hash-pinned original x86 routines executed with disclosed runtime substitutions; independent Python sampler, no native RNG or prior-solver identity claim.

sources.role: Application identity, download, version and supporting guides.

Dose standardization, six-parameter toxicity model, independent gamma priors, single-agent historical likelihood, stage-one expansion and interpolation, posterior target contour, and second-stage criteria.
Scenario surfaces including zero alpha coefficients, prior inputs and native use of second-derivative information in place of the paper's displayed formula.
Trial conduct, patient data and native files.
Four named truth surfaces; revised beta3 prior with mean1 and variance0.9, distinct from the paper's mean0.05 and variance3.
Original 1.1.1 executable, configuration and bundled 2004 example data; recovered MAP, observed information, allocation and controller contracts.

stage_two_limitation: Resolved for advertised modes 1 and 4: original code uses expected determinant of observed negative-log-posterior Hessians with eigenvalue floor 0.1, at the original-history MAP. This differs from the paper/guide simplification. Native solver/MCMC/RNG identity, full GUI/file parity and the documented GUI SD/SEM discrepancy remain separate limits.
validation_reference: tools/reference_toxfinder.R independently evaluates official example surfaces, integrates a nonconjugate scalar posterior, and calculates analytic log-gamma prior moments in base R. The script contains no original program source. tools/reference_toxfinder_native.py executes original bounded optimizer, full information chain, stage-one and grid controllers and bilinear surface. Original archived trial-zero report calculations checked independently at 60 decimal digits.
